
		<h1 class="postTitle">
			<a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/rls/p/22544767" title="发布于 2026-08-18 14:41">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">AC696X-双模蓝牙功耗与时隙分析</span>
    

</a>

		</h1>
		<div class="clear"></div>
		<div class="postBody">
			<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h3 id="ble/br协议栈时隙-1需求">1 需求</h3>
<p>使用手上现有的JL开发板测试，通过射频电路开启后会额外消耗10-20mA的电流来反推实际射频电路的工作状态；</p>
<p>通过射频电路的工作状态来反推射频电路的时隙分布，快速验证 需求可行性；</p>
<h3 id="ble/br协议栈时隙-2BR蓝牙">2 BR 蓝牙</h3>
<h4 id="ble/br协议栈时隙-2.1未连接">2.1 未连接</h4>
<p>EDR约200ms左右进行一次inquery scan，当接收到手机的inquery请求之后，EDR就会立即进入page scan数据交互；</p>
<p>可知EDR的接收射频开启的电流约20mA；</p>
<p><span class="confluence-embedded-file-wrapper confluence-embedded-manual-size"><img src="http://192.168.110.77:8090/download/attachments/20496395/%E5%B1%8F%E5%B9%95%E6%88%AA%E5%9B%BE%202026-07-30%20200210.png?version=1&amp;modificationDate=1785412948684&amp;api=v2" alt="" class="confluence-embedded-image" height="400" data-image-src="/download/attachments/20496395/%E5%B1%8F%E5%B9%95%E6%88%AA%E5%9B%BE%202026-07-30%20200210.png?version=1&amp;modificationDate=1785412948684&amp;api=v2" data-unresolved-comment-count="0" data-linked-resource-id="20496424" data-linked-resource-version="1" data-linked-resource-type="attachment" data-linked-resource-default-alias="屏幕截图 2026-07-30 200210.png" data-base-url="http://192.168.110.77:8090" data-linked-resource-content-type="image/png" data-linked-resource-container-id="20496395" data-linked-resource-container-version="7"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1371863/202608/1371863-20260804160609251-352409912.png" alt="屏幕截图 2026-07-30 200210" height="601" width="964"></span></p>
<h4 id="ble/br协议栈时隙-2.2连接未播放音乐，未通话；">2.2 连接未播放音乐，未通话；</h4>
<p>EDR蓝牙以625us作为一个数据slot周期，一个tx+rx为1.25ms；每10ms有8次交互；</p>
<p>rx射频电路每次都开启，接收应答包；后续开sniff优化后可仅在约定的rx响应即可；约20ms tx开启回复一次数据；</p>
<p>可知EDR的发送射频开启的电流为40mA；</p>
<p><span class="confluence-embedded-file-wrapper confluence-embedded-manual-size"><img src="http://192.168.110.77:8090/download/attachments/20496395/%E4%BF%9D%E6%8C%81%E8%BF%9E%E6%8E%A5%E6%B2%A1%E6%9C%89%E6%92%AD%E6%94%BE%E9%9F%B3%E4%B9%90%E7%9A%84%E6%B3%A2%E5%BD%A2.png?version=1&amp;modificationDate=1785415457262&amp;api=v2" alt="" class="confluence-embedded-image" height="400" data-image-src="/download/attachments/20496395/%E4%BF%9D%E6%8C%81%E8%BF%9E%E6%8E%A5%E6%B2%A1%E6%9C%89%E6%92%AD%E6%94%BE%E9%9F%B3%E4%B9%90%E7%9A%84%E6%B3%A2%E5%BD%A2.png?version=1&amp;modificationDate=1785415457262&amp;api=v2" data-unresolved-comment-count="0" data-linked-resource-id="20496441" data-linked-resource-version="1" data-linked-resource-type="attachment" data-linked-resource-default-alias="保持连接没有播放音乐的波形.png" data-base-url="http://192.168.110.77:8090" data-linked-resource-content-type="image/png" data-linked-resource-container-id="20496395" data-linked-resource-container-version="7"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1371863/202608/1371863-20260804160635466-1492205840.png" alt="保持连接没有播放音乐的波形" height="581" width="934"></span></p>
<h4 id="ble/br协议栈时隙-2.3连接播放音乐">2.3 连接播放音乐</h4>
<p>箭头部分为rx接包，黄色框出为tx slot 回复包；</p>
<p>图2可知rx单包约3.75ms，6slot，acl包为"2-DH5"，单包可解压14.5ms的音频；</p>
<p>图1时间轴共160ms，11包acl包可解压159.5ms音频；单秒68包约986ms音频；</p>
<p>实际时隙占空比和理论值一致约11*3.75ms/160ms = 25.7%；</p>
<p><span class="confluence-embedded-file-wrapper confluence-embedded-manual-size"><img src="http://192.168.110.77:8090/download/attachments/20496395/2.3%E8%BF%9E%E6%8E%A5%E6%92%AD%E6%94%BE%E9%9F%B3%E4%B9%901%282%29.png?version=1&amp;modificationDate=1785818454289&amp;api=v2" alt="" class="confluence-embedded-image" height="400" data-image-src="/download/attachments/20496395/2.3%E8%BF%9E%E6%8E%A5%E6%92%AD%E6%94%BE%E9%9F%B3%E4%B9%901%282%29.png?version=1&amp;modificationDate=1785818454289&amp;api=v2" data-unresolved-comment-count="0" data-linked-resource-id="20496816" data-linked-resource-version="1" data-linked-resource-type="attachment" data-linked-resource-default-alias="2.3连接播放音乐1(2).png" data-base-url="http://192.168.110.77:8090" data-linked-resource-content-type="image/png" data-linked-resource-container-id="20496395" data-linked-resource-container-version="7"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1371863/202608/1371863-20260804160707501-2108347541.png" alt="2.3连接播放音乐1(2)" height="586" width="978"></span></p>
<p><span class="confluence-embedded-file-wrapper confluence-embedded-manual-size"><img src="http://192.168.110.77:8090/download/attachments/20496395/2.3%E8%BF%9E%E6%8E%A5%E6%92%AD%E6%94%BE%E9%9F%B3%E4%B9%90.png?version=1&amp;modificationDate=1785465721209&amp;api=v2" alt="" class="confluence-embedded-image" height="400" data-image-src="/download/attachments/20496395/2.3%E8%BF%9E%E6%8E%A5%E6%92%AD%E6%94%BE%E9%9F%B3%E4%B9%90.png?version=1&amp;modificationDate=1785465721209&amp;api=v2" data-unresolved-comment-count="0" data-linked-resource-id="20496467" data-linked-resource-version="1" data-linked-resource-type="attachment" data-linked-resource-default-alias="2.3连接播放音乐.png" data-base-url="http://192.168.110.77:8090" data-linked-resource-content-type="image/png" data-linked-resource-container-id="20496395" data-linked-resource-container-version="7"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1371863/202608/1371863-20260804160726823-1824707339.png" alt="2.3连接播放音乐" height="593" width="972"></span></p>
<h4 id="ble/br协议栈时隙-2.4连接开启通话">2.4 连接开启通话</h4>
<p>黄色框为esco包的rx+tx slot 1.25ms；绿色框 1ms为cpu上行语音处理电流，紫色框0.8ms为cpu下行语音处理电流；未标识波峰未rx空闲应答电流；</p>
<p>通话hfp的esco包为12slot 共7.5ms；推测esco包为'2-EV3'；</p>
<p>实际时隙占空比和理论值一致1.25/7.5 =16.7%；</p>
<p><span class="confluence-embedded-file-wrapper confluence-embedded-manual-size"><img src="http://192.168.110.77:8090/download/attachments/20496395/2.4hfp-15ms1%281%29.png?version=1&amp;modificationDate=1785826135321&amp;api=v2" alt="" class="confluence-embedded-image" height="400" data-image-src="/download/attachments/20496395/2.4hfp-15ms1%281%29.png?version=1&amp;modificationDate=1785826135321&amp;api=v2" data-unresolved-comment-count="0" data-linked-resource-id="20496833" data-linked-resource-version="1" data-linked-resource-type="attachment" data-linked-resource-default-alias="2.4hfp-15ms1(1).png" data-base-url="http://192.168.110.77:8090" data-linked-resource-content-type="image/png" data-linked-resource-container-id="20496395" data-linked-resource-container-version="7"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1371863/202608/1371863-20260804160747139-1993376849.png" alt="2.4hfp-15ms1(1)" height="597" width="988"></span></p>
<h4 id="ble/br协议栈时隙-3BLE蓝牙">3 BLE 蓝牙</h4>
<p>我们先看下当前需求对于BLE蓝牙时隙的要求是咋样的；</p>

<td class="confluenceTd">90 ms</td>
<td class="confluenceTd">11.2次</td>
<td class="confluenceTd">11.2*112&nbsp; = 1255 bps</td>
<td class="confluenceTd">1600 bps /200 Bytes</td>

<blockquote>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">AirPkg = Preamble (1B) + Access Address (4B) + Header (2B) + &nbsp;[ MIC(4B)加密可选] + Payload (27B) + CRC (3B)</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">最小空中包是10字节固定开销，通过抓包工具抓取后可能会附加上抓包工具的数据长度导致不是10字节而是26字节；</p>
<div class="table-wrap">
<table class="confluenceTable stickyTableHeaders tablesorter tablesorter-default" role="grid">
<thead class="">
<tr class="tablesorter-headerRow" role="row"></tr>
</thead>
<tbody class="">
<tr class="" role="row">
<td class="confluenceTd"><span class="">前导码（Preamble）</span></td>
<td class="confluenceTd"><span class="">1 字节（LE 1M）</span><br><span class="">2 字节（LE 2M）</span><br><span class="">10 字节（LE Coded，80 bits）</span></td>
<td class="confluenceTd"><span class="">用于接收机同步和自动增益控制</span></td>
</tr>
<tr class="" role="row">
<td class="confluenceTd"><span class="">访问地址（Access Address）</span></td>
<td class="confluenceTd"><span class="">4 字节</span></td>
<td class="confluenceTd"><span class="">连接时为随机生成的值，广播为固定&nbsp;</span><code>0x8E89BED6</code></td>
</tr>
<tr class="" role="row">
<td class="confluenceTd"><span class="">PDU 报头（Header）</span></td>
<td class="confluenceTd"><span class="">2 字节（16 bits）</span></td>
<td class="confluenceTd"><span class="">包含 LLID、SN、NESN、MD 及长度等信息</span></td>
</tr>
<tr class="" role="row">
<td class="confluenceTd"><span class="">消息完整性校验（MIC）</span></td>
<td class="confluenceTd"><span class="">4 字节（仅加密连接）</span></td>
<td class="confluenceTd"><span class="">如果链路加密，这部分会附加在有效数据之后，算在有效负载内</span></td>
</tr>
<tr class="" role="row">
<td class="confluenceTd"><span class="">CRC</span></td>
<td class="confluenceTd"><span class="">3 字节（24 bits）</span></td>
<td class="confluenceTd"><span class="">对整个 PDU 的校验</span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
</blockquote>
<p>根据前面的BR的电流时隙推测，协议栈时隙不到30%使用率，</p>
<p>当前已经可以知道在EDR时隙上额外加35kbps的数据，额外50次connEvent，对于协议栈时隙而言，毫无压力；</p>
<p>虽然已经知道理论可行了，还是把测试结果补充完整，增加说服力些吧；</p>
<p>那就基于当前JL开发板，额外加个BLE模拟55次connEvent和35kbps数据传输；EDR正常工作时，ble从设备开启notify通知朝手机发送数据；</p>
<p>本小节先单独测试下只有ble时的电流时隙分布；后面小节再进行edr +ble 的二合一；</p>
<h4 id="ble/br协议栈时隙-3.1ble从设备连接时">3.1 ble从设备连接时</h4>
<p>保持连接但是没有数据交互时，配置connInterval连接间隔15ms，slaveLatency跳过次数0，每秒内connEvent交互次数66次；</p>
<p><span class="confluence-embedded-file-wrapper confluence-embedded-manual-size"><img src="http://192.168.110.77:8090/download/attachments/20496395/%E4%BB%85%E7%BB%B4%E6%8C%81%E8%BF%9E%E6%8E%A5%E7%9A%8415ms%E7%9A%84connEvent.png?version=1&amp;modificationDate=1785757465927&amp;api=v2" alt="" class="confluence-embedded-image" height="250" data-image-src="/download/attachments/20496395/%E4%BB%85%E7%BB%B4%E6%8C%81%E8%BF%9E%E6%8E%A5%E7%9A%8415ms%E7%9A%84connEvent.png?version=1&amp;modificationDate=1785757465927&amp;api=v2" data-unresolved-comment-count="0" data-linked-resource-id="20496738" data-linked-resource-version="1" data-linked-resource-type="attachment" data-linked-resource-default-alias="仅维持连接的15ms的connEvent.png" data-base-url="http://192.168.110.77:8090" data-linked-resource-content-type="image/png" data-linked-resource-container-id="20496395" data-linked-resource-container-version="7"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1371863/202608/1371863-20260804160815987-28982922.png" alt="仅维持连接的15ms的connEvent" height="424" width="1204"></span></p>
<h4 id="ble/br协议栈时隙-3.2ble从设备订阅后">3.2 ble从设备订阅后</h4>
<p>实测当前sdk的链路层的空中包DLE(dataLenExtention)固定写死27, 修改无效，空中包单次connEvent一帧达不到251字节，payload仅27；</p>
<p>(单次connEvent最大Payload实际只有27，为当前 JL sdk 协议栈未优化；理论应支持单次connEvent 251 payload；)</p>
<p>节约connEvent使用一包att&nbsp; 69 Bytes有效数据 需要3个connEvent；每秒内有效数据66*69 =4554字节；</p>
<p>可知ble从 配置connIntrval连接周期15ms时，66cnt/s，4554Bytes/s；时隙占比约为2ms/15ms = 13.4%；</p>
<p><span class="confluence-embedded-file-wrapper confluence-embedded-manual-size"><img src="http://192.168.110.77:8090/download/attachments/20496395/%E8%BF%9E%E6%8E%A5%E4%BA%8B%E4%BB%B63connevent.png?version=1&amp;modificationDate=1785757723318&amp;api=v2" alt="" class="confluence-embedded-image" height="250" data-image-src="/download/attachments/20496395/%E8%BF%9E%E6%8E%A5%E4%BA%8B%E4%BB%B63connevent.png?version=1&amp;modificationDate=1785757723318&amp;api=v2" data-unresolved-comment-count="0" data-linked-resource-id="20496739" data-linked-resource-version="1" data-linked-resource-type="attachment" data-linked-resource-default-alias="连接事件3connevent.png" data-base-url="http://192.168.110.77:8090" data-linked-resource-content-type="image/png" data-linked-resource-container-id="20496395" data-linked-resource-container-version="7"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1371863/202608/1371863-20260804160838134-847385851.png" alt="连接事件3connevent" height="432" width="1213"></span></p>
<p>将第一个波峰放大后可知，每个tx约300us = 37字节 = Preamble (1B) + Access Address (4B) + Header (2B) + Payload (27B) + CRC (3B)，交叉验证ok；</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1371863/202608/1371863-20260804160856694-807913618.png" alt="连接事件3放大图" height="446" width="763"></p>
<h3 id="ble/br协议栈时隙-4EDR+BLE功能同时开启">4 EDR +BLE功能同时开启</h3>
<h4 id="ble/br协议栈时隙-4.1BLE+音乐播放时">4.1 BLE + 音乐播放时</h4>
<p>结合音乐播放的2.3小节 +ble订阅数据的3.2小节，对比可知，当前蓝牙协议栈时隙占比约40%；</p>
<p><span class="confluence-embedded-file-wrapper confluence-embedded-manual-size"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1371863/202608/1371863-20260804160916369-1471916063.png" alt="播放音乐和ble共存的时序" height="576" width="967"><img src="http://192.168.110.77:8090/download/attachments/20496395/%E6%92%AD%E6%94%BE%E9%9F%B3%E4%B9%90%E5%92%8Cble%E5%85%B1%E5%AD%98%E7%9A%84%E6%97%B6%E5%BA%8F.png?version=1&amp;modificationDate=1785761673206&amp;api=v2" alt="" class="confluence-embedded-image" height="400" data-image-src="/download/attachments/20496395/%E6%92%AD%E6%94%BE%E9%9F%B3%E4%B9%90%E5%92%8Cble%E5%85%B1%E5%AD%98%E7%9A%84%E6%97%B6%E5%BA%8F.png?version=1&amp;modificationDate=1785761673206&amp;api=v2" data-unresolved-comment-count="0" data-linked-resource-id="20496745" data-linked-resource-version="1" data-linked-resource-type="attachment" data-linked-resource-default-alias="播放音乐和ble共存的时序.png" data-base-url="http://192.168.110.77:8090" data-linked-resource-content-type="image/png" data-linked-resource-container-id="20496395" data-linked-resource-container-version="7"></span></p>
<h4 id="ble/br协议栈时隙-4.2BLE+通话">4.2 BLE + 通话</h4>
<p>黄色框为hfp通话包的rx+tx slot；绿色框为ble发送数据的connEvent；</p>
<p>绿色框放大后可知，tx的持续周期约为350us，为单个connEvent，最大payload27字节，当前测试使用23Bytes；</p>
<p>前面当ble测试和 ble+音乐 时，单个connInterval内都有多个connEvent，</p>
<p>这里 ble+通话 单个connInterval只剩1个connEvent了；ble速率缩为3分之1；每秒内有效数据1800Bytes/s；</p>
<p>这里没有3个connEvent一起发或者扩展DLE，应该是这个芯片的JL sdk 闭源的协议栈部分没有对此优化，时隙本身十分充裕；</p>
<p>每15ms内有2个hfp slot 1.25*2ms，一个ble connEvent 1.25ms，时隙占空比3.75/15 = 25%；</p>
<p><span class="confluence-embedded-file-wrapper confluence-embedded-manual-size"><img src="http://192.168.110.77:8090/download/attachments/20496395/4.2ble%E9%80%9A%E8%AF%9D1.jpeg?version=1&amp;modificationDate=1785811470268&amp;api=v2" alt="" class="confluence-embedded-image" height="250" data-image-src="/download/attachments/20496395/4.2ble%E9%80%9A%E8%AF%9D1.jpeg?version=1&amp;modificationDate=1785811470268&amp;api=v2" data-unresolved-comment-count="0" data-linked-resource-id="20496764" data-linked-resource-version="1" data-linked-resource-type="attachment" data-linked-resource-default-alias="4.2ble通话1.jpeg" data-base-url="http://192.168.110.77:8090" data-linked-resource-content-type="image/jpeg" data-linked-resource-container-id="20496395" data-linked-resource-container-version="7"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1371863/202608/1371863-20260804160936454-775262089.jpg" alt="4.2ble通话1" height="384" width="1053"></span></p>
<h3 id="ble/br协议栈时隙-5小结">5 小结</h3>
<p>当前蓝牙协议栈实测ble和edr同时工作时，协议栈时隙使用率最大值只有40%；时隙不是问题；</p>
<p>当前方案主要风险点在于需要原厂提供二主二从的定制化sdk，并对ble的蓝牙协议栈进行参数优化；</p>
<p>猜测原厂需要修改的代码可能就是将当前2实例复制成多个实例，加些buff，特别是部分边界取值的参数需要注意下；然后就是拉通对齐；</p>

</div>
